# Types

Value types, used in function parameters and return types. 11 entries. Search all of them on the [reference home](./index.md).

In a pattern, `%type%` is a value, `[...]` is optional and `(a|b)` means one of the words.

## Boolean {#boolean}

```carve
boolean
```

`true` or `false` (also `yes` and `no`).

Since **unreleased** · Guide: [types](../syntax/types.md)
